title: Name things with several words
objective: Write clear names of more than one word, and use them the same way every time.

body.text: A name can have several words. Put a space between the words, and Lagom reads them as one name. Names such as high score or lamp oil say what a value is, which is easier to read than a short name like h or x.

body.title: Several-word names
body.code:
make first name equal to "Ada"
make high score equal to 100
say first name
say high score

body.text: Write the name the same way each time you use it. Once a value is made changing, set and increase can use the same multi-word name.

body.title: Changing a several-word name
body.code:
make changing lamp oil equal to 10
set lamp oil to lamp oil minus 1
say lamp oil

body.prompt: The value 100 is a high score, but the name score does not say so. Give it a name that reads like words, and the program should still print 100.
body.starter:
make score equal to 100
say score
body.solution:
make high score equal to 100
say high score

checks.description: The variable is named high score
